scenarios.name: Cancel a staged ribbon customization during a modeling command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid block in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user starts Shell from Modify
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
the user opens the Options panel title context menu
the user selects Customize User Commands
the Ribbon customization dialog opens with Part Tools as the target
the Shell properties and model preview remain visible behind the dialog
the user adds 2D Sketches to the target list
the target is marked as changed
the target list contains 2D Sketches
the user cancels customization
the customization dialog closes without adding a User Commands panel
the Shell properties and model preview remain visible
the user selects a face of the block
the Shell Remove field reports 1 Face
the model preview shows the selected face removed
the user cancels Shell
the Shell properties and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
